definition_used: Any question, controversy or dispute about one or more images, or part(s) of one or more images.
caution: The definition is broad and does not specify the nature of the concern, so process_signal and actor_context are left as default/unclear. Only research_content_reliability is assigned because image concerns directly relate to the reliability of presented data.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a dispute about images, which directly pertains to the reliability of research content (data). No specific process or actor is indicated.
